opportunities.title: APEX Awards
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Established independent researchers with a strong track record; hold a permanent or fixed-term position covering the duration of the award; have teaching and admin duties from which they can be relieved; based in a UK University or UK not-for-profit research organisation. Up to two Co-applicants covering different Academy remits.
opportunities.summary: Cross-Academy scheme (British Academy, Royal Society, Royal Academy of Engineering, supported by Leverhulme Trust) offering established independent researchers funding for genuine interdisciplinary, curiosity-driven research that benefits wider society, with emphasis on the boundary between science, engineering, and the social sciences and humanities.

opportunities.title: Postdoctoral Fellowships

amount.raw: FEC regime; Academy funds 80 per cent of salary costs, directly allocated and indirect costs under FEC. Three-year award.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early-career researchers in the humanities and social sciences based at an eligible UK university or research organisation. British citizens and EEA nationals eligible regardless of where doctorate obtained; anyone with a UK doctorate eligible; or strong prior association with UK academic community. Viva Voce completed between 1 April 2024 and 1 April 2027. Must not have held a permanent academic post.
opportunities.summary: Three-year fellowship for outstanding early-career researchers in the humanities or social sciences to pursue an independent research project and complete a significant piece of publishable research, strengthening their experience of research and teaching.

opportunities.title: Talent Development Awards 2026-27
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Established researchers in the humanities and social sciences ordinarily resident in the UK holding a current long-term appointment at a UK-based Higher Education Institution (HEI) or Independent Research Organisation (IRO) continuing for the full duration of the award.
opportunities.summary: Supports UK-based researchers to acquire and advance skills in relevant areas (quantitative skills, data science, digital humanities, languages), supporting innovative research methods through skills development, collaboration or dissemination.

opportunities.title: Global Innovation Fellowships: The German Council on Foreign Relations (DGAP) 2026-27

amount.raw: up to £150,000 for 12 months (with Full Economic Costing at 80 per cent)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK-based early- and mid-career researchers from across the humanities and social sciences. Applications invited in areas including Security/Defence/Resilience, Indo-European Relations, Technology and AI, and Strategy-Making in Europe.
opportunities.summary: Fourth call providing up to two one-year Global Innovation Fellowships for UK-based early- and mid-career SHAPE researchers to be embedded in the office of the German Council on Foreign Relations (DGAP) in Berlin, developing skills, networks and careers across policy, public, private and creative sectors.

opportunities.title: SHAPE Involve and Engage
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Any researcher based in the UK who meets the conditions of the call, from any career stage. No prior British Academy funding required. Previous successful recipients of this award are not eligible to reapply.
opportunities.summary: Public engagement programme supporting ambitious projects to engage the public with the humanities and social sciences, working in partnership with a gallery, archive, library, museum (GLAM organisation) or performing arts organisation.

opportunities.title: The Alexander von Humboldt Foundation and The British Academy Knowledge Frontiers Symposium 2027

amount.raw: The symposium covers travel, accommodation, and visa costs. Seed funding available for collaborations.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early career researchers affiliated with research institutions in the UK or Germany, with research interest in the theme 'Humans and Nature: More resilient towards the future'.
opportunities.summary: Research collaboration symposium (21-23 April 2027) bringing together around fifteen early career researchers from the UK and fifteen from Germany across the humanities and social sciences to discuss 'Humans and Nature: More resilient towards the future', encouraging collaboration and networking, with seed funding for international collaborations.

opportunities.title: International Interdisciplinary Research Projects 2027

amount.raw: up to £300,000 over 2 years at 80% FEC (total project value at 100% FEC may not exceed £375,000)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Principal Investigator must be a researcher from the humanities and social sciences based at an eligible UK university or research institute, holding an established role lasting the duration of the award, of postdoctoral or above status, planning to spend at least 20% of their time (0.2 FTE) on the award. Co-Applicants based overseas required. Collaboration across disciplines required.
opportunities.summary: International interdisciplinary research programme supporting projects on the theme of 'Mobilities' (movement of people, things and ideas), led by and grounded in the humanities and/or social sciences, working with international partners and ranging across SHAPE and STEM disciplines.

opportunities.title: Additional Needs
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Current British Academy award-holders OR applicants intending to apply for a British Academy award in the next six months who need support with submitting their application. Must meet the eligibility requirements of the scheme they intend to apply for.
opportunities.summary: Funding to support additional needs that applicants and award-holders may require, in addition to research expenses, e.g. specific equipment to overcome barriers for disabled researchers, assistance for sensory impairment, caring costs for research trips, and support to make an application to a British Academy call. Offered on a rolling deadline.
